The problem

The deal goes to whoever looks safer online. Not whoever does better work.

You have the credibility. The stories. The proof. Most of it lives in your head and in closed loans nobody outside the company ever sees. Your borrower is quietly researching for weeks before they reach out, and so is every agent deciding who to refer. They pick whoever earns trust fastest.

Posting fixes that. But posting is the job you never have time for. So you post in bursts, then go quiet. A stale feed reads worse than never starting.

The Signal Engine takes the two jobs you cannot sustain off your plate: making the content, and keeping it consistent. You keep the one job only you can do. Being the real person with something to say.

Case study · DG Lending

What one foundation shoot made for a mortgage brokerage.

We filmed the DG Lending team and their clients and built a library they could post from for months. Long-form films, from a company overview to a first-time homebuyer guide and a client testimonial. Short-form cuts in vertical and square, each with a caption written in their voice. Photos of the team at work. And an activation guide showing where every piece goes on their website, on social and in email.

DG Lending’s project was a foundation build, made before the monthly engine existed. The Signal Engine is that foundation with the monthly rhythm on top.

Before the cameras

We find your North Star first.

Great content starts with a clear story, not a camera. Before we film anything, we get to the core of who you are and what your business stands for. That is the work that makes every piece after it land.

01

Async setup: systems, without a meeting

We set up your accounts asynchronously. A short walkthrough video, plus links in a shared Google Drive and Gmail. Nothing to schedule. You click through on your own time and you are wired in.

02

Survey: tell us the business

You fill out a creative discovery survey on your business. The basics, the borrowers, the wins, the stuff in your head. It gives us the raw material and makes the first call sharp instead of slow.

03

Audience research: we read the room

We dig into what your audience actually wants. Your Google reviews, the questions borrowers keep asking, the language they use. Real signal, not guesswork, before we ever point a camera.

04

The North Star call: one hour on your story

Our first call together. One focused hour of questions that pulls the core of your story out of you. What you want to be known for, and what your audience needs. Together we set the North Star.

The deliverable

Your Content Marketing Guide

Everything from that hour becomes one document. Your North Star: what you stand for, what you want to be known for, and what your audience wants from you. Every clip, post and caption we make gets checked against it. It is the reason your content sounds like you and points one direction, instead of noise that could belong to anyone.

The rhythm

One big shoot to start. Then we keep it alive.

Every engagement opens with the foundational shoot. From there we draw fresh content from what we captured, with no new filming until the next quarter. Then the rhythm keeps the library alive: on the ground with you once a quarter, a guided remote session every month in between, and self-serve phone prompts to fill the gaps.

01

Kickoff

Evergreen Foundation. The same core build every time, capturing content that stays relevant all year.

02

Every quarter

Onsite capture. We come to you. Richer footage, deeper stories, and the in-person time that keeps the relationship and the trust real.

03

Every month

Remote half-day. A coached remote session against the month’s planned topics. Keeps the feed current and the library stocked between onsites.

04

Between sessions

Guided phone captures. We prepare the topics and hand you a simple filming guide. You film short answers whenever it suits you. We fold them into the library.

The Evergreen Foundation

Everything you need to launch.

Every engagement starts here. The kickoff shoot builds one fixed launch kit: your story, your proof, the answers to the objections that cost you loans, a lead magnet, the images to round out the feed, and a guide to where every piece goes. This library works all year, and the retainer draws from it before we ever film again.

Productized on purpose

Three rules keep this a product, not a custom project.

They protect your price and our speed, and they are written down, so there is never a grey area.

01

Fixed count

You get the same deliverable numbers every month. More than the stack means a bigger plan or a top-up. Never a favor, never a surprise.

02

Set formats

Topics change every month. Deliverable shapes never do. You bring the stories. We own the formats. Nothing net-new gets invented mid-engagement.

03

One capture in

Everything flows from the scheduled capture: the kickoff foundation, then the quarterly onsite and monthly remote. It keeps turnaround fast and quality consistent.
